# Lab 11.9: Create a Hierarchical Firewall Policy

## What We Are Going to Do
Create an organization-level firewall policy that blocks a bad IP range everywhere and delegates other traffic to project rules.

## Steps

1. **Create the policy at the organization.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-policies create \
  --organization=ORG_ID \
  --short-name=org-baseline \
  --description="Org-wide baseline rules"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Block a range for every VPC.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-policies rules create 100 \
  --firewall-policy=org-baseline --organization=ORG_ID \
  --direction=INGRESS --action=deny \
  --src-ip-ranges=198.51.100.0/24 \
  --layer4-configs=all --enable-logging</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Always allow IAP and health checks.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-policies rules create 200 \
  --firewall-policy=org-baseline --organization=ORG_ID \
  --direction=INGRESS --action=allow \
  --src-ip-ranges=35.235.240.0/20,130.211.0.0/22,35.191.0.0/16 \
  --layer4-configs=tcp</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Delegate everything else.** A `goto_next` rule passes other traffic down to folder policies and VPC rules.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-policies rules create 1000 \
  --firewall-policy=org-baseline --organization=ORG_ID \
  --direction=INGRESS --action=goto_next \
  --src-ip-ranges=0.0.0.0/0 --layer4-configs=all</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Attach it to the organization.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-policies associations create \
  --firewall-policy=org-baseline --organization=ORG_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **See the effective rules on a VPC.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute networks get-effective-firewalls default</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The org rules appear first, above the VPC rules.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-policies associations delete \
  --firewall-policy=org-baseline --organization=ORG_ID --name=org-ORG_ID
gcloud compute firewall-policies delete org-baseline --organization=ORG_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Blocked range | Denied in every VPC in the org |
| `goto_next` | Hands the decision to the next level |
| Project admins | Cannot override an org deny |
| Order | Org, folder, then VPC rules |
